sentence_stem: Even though the test was difficult,
full_sentence: Even though the test was difficult, she got a good grade.
acceptable_variants: she still passed with high marks.

options.text: so she went to bed early.
options.why_wrong: 'So' introduces a result, which does not match the contrast that 'even though' sets up.
This adds a fact about the test but does not complete the contrast started by 'even though'.

options.text: she was studying at the library.
options.why_wrong: This describes an activity but does not show the unexpected outcome that 'even though' requires.

explanation: After 'even though', the second clause must show a result that goes against the expectation created by the first clause. Learners may be tempted to use a result connector such as 'so' here, because the concessive pattern is built differently in Turkish and the two ideas can feel similar.
